findings.place: tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js, assertNothingOf (lines 480-502) as used by isolation (lines 1169-1185); decisions/0109 addendum О17, second point (a text of one word compared with the whole string values)
findings.what: Criterion 6 (Q8): B's network answers 'hold none of' A's texts. О17 compares every one-word text of A with the whole string values of B's answers, because single common words of A stand inside B's own texts on the correct server. The rule is wider than that reason: of the 12 one-word texts of A in the two pairs, 9 stand inside no ru text of B's tenant file, A's own name among them (pair 1: «Учёт-Про»; pair 2: «Лидвейв», «Услуги», «Товары», «Недвижимость», «Instagram», «TikTok», «WhatsApp», «Звонки»), and a leak of such a text inside a string of B's answer is not seen. Own mutants, both pairs: N05 (server: B's first question title gets ' (<name of A>)') and N09 (server: the summary of B's first recommended solution gets ' (<name of A>)'): isolation stays green (exit 0, 9 of 9), while B's questionnaire answer (N05) or B's result answer (N09) holds «Учёт-Про» / «Лидвейв» inside a string (measured without a browser on the same servers). The card check cannot see it: the leak is on the question screen and in the result body.
findings.how_to_fix: In assertNothingOf compare a one-word text of A with the whole string values only when it stands inside some ru string of B's tenant file (any field of the file: questions, solutions, rules, result texts; the test already reads that file as fileOfB); look for every other text of A as a part of every string value, as for the texts with a blank. Measured with this rule (no browser, my oracle): correct server 0 hits in B's questionnaire and result answers in both pairs; N05 -> «Учёт-Про» and «Лидвейв» in B's questionnaire answer; N09 -> the same in B's result; W01, W02, N02, N06 still hit. The second point of О17 needs this precision first (issue I1).

issues.text: For ORCH: the fix of F4 changes the second point of decisions/0109 О17 (one-word texts compared with whole values): the exception would cover only the one-word texts of A that stand inside a ru string of B's tenant file (today «человек», «Средний», «Обучение»), every other text of A is looked for as a part. Measured: 0 hits on the correct server, N05 and N09 red. The precision is needed before TEST-FIXER (pass 3 of 3 is the last); DOC-UPDATER then writes it into criterion 6 together with О17.

For ORCH: F5 (Low) - the premise of О18 is measured false (a Node-only, deterministic catcher of V12 through deps.spawn exists, probe in <scratch>/e2e105g2/probe). Either TEST-DESIGNER adds the case or О18 is corrected and V12 recorded with the numbers (whole file 21 of 21; alone 0 of 30 quiet, 19 of 30 under load).

An exception to a check (a whole value in place of a part) is bounded by its measured reason: when the reason is 'these words stand inside B's own texts', the exception is computed from B's texts, not given to a whole class (every one-word text); otherwise it hides the most telling member of the class (here A's own name: N05, N09). Pass 1 found the same shape for every text (F2), О17 kept it for the one-word texts.
